en: Dependent on a leading-out state, a non-leading-out state arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a non-leading-out state, a non-leading-out state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on both a leading-out and a non-leading-out state, a non-leading-out state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
